title: Keep a notes or evaluations continuation valid when records were only appended after its cut
outcome: Keep a notes or evaluations continuation valid when records were only appended after its cut
acceptance: A show --notes/--gates (and the other record windows) continuation taken before a new note, gate or observation is appended to the same item keeps paging the older rows it announced, instead of refusing with "the window changed; start a fresh window"
A continuation is still refused when the boundary record no longer matches, when it belongs to another item or window kind, or when its cut is in the future
A behavioural test captures a first page, appends a note to the item, follows the continuation and receives exactly the older rows; a second test proves the boundary-mismatch refusal still fires
No new state, protection layer or wall-clock assertion is introduced
